approvals.reason: Upstream makes updated_at nullable for a layout that was never saved. The web client reads a missing timestamp as unsaved and offers a reset, so the field's absence is a defined state.
Upstream makes layout nullable until an administrator saves one. The web client seeds the default layout for a null body, so the field's absence is a defined state.
Upstream retires the single-entry download read. The web client now pages GET /api/v2/downloads and finds the row there; no shipped client calls the removed operation.
